title: Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Polished Chrome | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Keep bath towels neatly hung and within easy reach while maintaining a clean, traditional look in Polished Chrome, which delivers a bright, mirror-like sheen that coordinates effortlessly with chrome faucets and modern fixtures.

Highlights:
- Polished Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Enjoy a cleaner finished appearance with concealed mounting hardware
- Save space in smaller baths with a wall-mounted design that uses vertical wall area

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: towel bar
- Length: 30-Inch
- Overall dimensions: 30 in L x 2 in D x 3.5 in H
- Weight: 3.2 lbs
- Material: solid brass
- Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware included
multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Design context: heritage bathroom fixtures styling within the Carolina Collection
